pay_detail: $17 per session, with a discount for the whole season. A limited number of scholarships are available.
notes: Fall 2026 dates are listed. The page does not list later sessions.
name: Young Writers' Studio (teens, grades 9 to 12)
what_you_do: Teens meet every other Tuesday evening to do writing exercises and share and discuss their own writing. You can join in person or by Zoom.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 sessions: Sep 1, Sep 15, Sep 29, Oct 13, Oct 27 and Nov 10, 2026. No registration deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Register online through the Young Writers' Studio page. For help paying, email Meg Brown (megbrown@thurberhouse.org).
